tasks.prompt:
Design a standardized documentation workflow system for the agent-orchestrator. This system should:

1. Define the 'system-documentation' task type that can be submitted to the orchestrator
2. Create specialized agents for documentation tasks (technical-writer, api-documenter, architecture-analyst, etc.)
3. Design a workflow that takes app_name, app_root_path, and generates standardized documentation in {app_root}/docs/
4. Create execution plan templates for documentation workflows
5. Define resume/checkpoint capabilities for interrupted documentation tasks

The goal is that users can simply run:
cd /apps/agent-orchestrator
python run_orchestrator_task.py --app-name 'my-app' --app-root '/path/to/app' --task-type 'system-documentation'

And the orchestrator will automatically generate complete documentation without any further input.

Create standardized documentation templates based on the workflow design. Create templates for:

1. README.md - Project overview, quick start, basic usage
2. ARCHITECTURE.md - System design, components, data flow
3. API_REFERENCE.md - Complete API documentation
4. USER_GUIDE.md - End-user documentation and tutorials
5. DEVELOPER_GUIDE.md - Development setup, contribution guidelines
6. DEPLOYMENT.md - Deployment and operations guide

Each template should be comprehensive but adaptable to different types of applications. Include placeholders for dynamic content generation.

Integrate the documentation workflow system into the agent-orchestrator. Create:

1. run_orchestrator_task.py script that accepts --app-name, --app-root, --task-type parameters
2. Task definition parser for 'system-documentation' task type
3. Agent registration for documentation-specialized agents
4. Workflow execution engine that uses the templates
5. Output management that creates docs in {app_root}/docs/ directory
6. Integration with existing checkpoint/resume system

Ensure the system works seamlessly with existing orchestrator capabilities.

Test the complete documentation workflow system. Create test cases for:

1. End-to-end documentation generation for a sample application
2. Resume capability testing (interrupt and restart)
3. Error handling and edge cases
4. Template customization and adaptation
5. Integration with existing orchestrator features

Provide a comprehensive test plan and validate that the system works as designed.
